questions.q: She decided ___ a new job.
questions.why: Після *decide* — інфінітив з *to*: *She decided to look for a new job.* Дієслова рішень і намірів (*decide, plan, hope, want*) зазвичай беруть *to*.

questions.q: He refused ___ me.
questions.why: Після *refuse* — *to* + дієслово: *He refused to help me.*

questions.q: I remember ___ the door — I'm sure it was locked.
questions.why: *remember* + *-ing* — пам'ятаю те, що вже зробив: *I remember locking the door.* *remember to lock* — не забути зробити (у майбутньому).

questions.q: Remember ___ the door when you leave.
questions.why: *remember* + *to* — не забути зробити: *Remember to lock the door.* *locking* означало б «пам'ятай, що зачинив».

questions.q: He stopped ___ (smoke) last year.
questions.why: *stop* + *-ing* — припинити робити (кинути): *He stopped smoking.* *stopped to smoke* — зупинився, щоб покурити.

questions.q: We stopped ___ a coffee. (зупинилися, щоб випити)
questions.why: *stop* + *to* — зупинитися, щоб зробити щось інше: *We stopped to have a coffee.*

questions.q: She told me ___ (wait) outside.
questions.why: *tell* + особа + *to* + дієслово: *She told me to wait outside.*

questions.q: They made us ___ for an hour.
questions.why: *make* + особа + дієслово без *to*: *They made us wait.*

questions.q: I regret ___ you that the flight is cancelled.
questions.why: *regret to tell you* — «з жалем повідомляю» (зараз, офіційно). *regret telling* — шкодую, що сказав раніше.
*forget to* — забути зробити: *He forgot to call her.*

questions.q: We can't afford ___ (buy) a new car.
questions.why: *afford* + *to*: *We can't afford to buy a new car.*

questions.q: She promised ___ (call) me.
questions.why: *promise* + *to*: *She promised to call me.*

questions.q: I'll never forget ___ (see) the ocean for the first time.
questions.why: *forget* + *-ing* — не забуду того, що було: *I'll never forget seeing the ocean.*

questions.q: Try ___ (turn) it off and on again.
questions.why: *try* + *-ing* — спробувати як експеримент (чи допоможе): *Try turning it off and on again.* *try to* — намагатися зробити щось важке.

questions.q: He managed ___ (finish) on time.
questions.why: *manage* + *to* — вдатися: *He managed to finish on time.*

questions.q: I tried ___ the window, but it was stuck.
questions.why: *try* + *to* — намагатися (і не вдалося): *I tried to open the window, but it was stuck.*

questions.q: It started ___ at noon.
questions.why: Після *start, begin, continue* можливі обидві форми без різниці в значенні.

questions.q: We agreed ___ at 6.
questions.why: *agree* + *to*: *We agreed to meet at 6.*

questions.q: I regret ___ her the truth. (шкодую, що сказав)
questions.why: *regret* + *-ing* — шкодую про те, що зробив: *I regret telling her the truth.*

answer: I decided to stay at home
questions.why: *decide* + *to*: *decided to stay*.

answer: She stopped talking when I came in
When I came in she stopped talking
questions.why: *stop* + *-ing* — припинити: *She stopped talking.*

answer: Please remember to buy some bread
questions.why: *remember to* — не забудь зробити.
questions.hint: Будь ласка, не забудь купити хліба.

questions.q: Can you show me how ___ this machine?
questions.why: Після питального слова — *to* + дієслово: *how to use this machine*.

questions.q: The windows need ___.
questions.why: *need* + *-ing* має пасивне значення: *The windows need cleaning* (= *need to be cleaned*).

questions.q: It takes an hour ___ there by train.
questions.why: *It takes* + час + *to* + дієслово: *It takes an hour to get there.*

questions.q: He went on ___ even when everyone had left.
questions.why: *go on* + *-ing* — продовжувати робити те саме: *He went on talking.* *go on to talk* — перейти до чогось нового.

questions.q: I didn't mean ___ (upset) you.
questions.why: *mean* + *to* — мати намір: *I didn't mean to upset you.*
